title: FDE Master Curriculum | Modular Syllabus from Beginner to Job-Ready
intro: Design approach: organize the complete knowledge map into modules and lessons without binding it to a fixed number of weeks. Each lesson includes detailed topics, learning outcomes, and estimated total study time. Modules can later be combined flexibly based on a learner’s background, goals, and weekly availability.

Curriculum principles: Less syntax, more systems. Start with the business problem. Add technical complexity only when the problem truly requires it. Puffo/Pavlov can serve as a rapid delivery abstraction layer, while the curriculum also explains the code, tools, state, data, permissions, and production engineering behind it.
overviewTitle: FDE Master Curriculum | Module Overview & Estimated Hours

fullPath.purpose: A complete knowledge and project pathway from near-beginner level to an entry-level / apprentice FDE job-search portfolio.
fullPath.notes: Not every learner needs the full path; the actual curriculum should be tailored to background and goals.
